answer: Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 12 epochs, which means holding a position presupposes ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Re-attestations are stored in willow and opal lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those as the attesters must be independent on the fable graph. A farm of 2124 identities would post 2952 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
